preconditions.description: The number of students n, acquaintances m, and groups k are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(c) == n and all(1 <= x <= k for x in c)
preconditions.description: The group assignment list c has exactly n elements, each being a valid group index between 1 and k.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == m and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: The list of acquaintance pairs has exactly m elements, each containing two distinct student indices within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(sorted(e)) for e in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: No unordered pair of students is mentioned more than once in the input.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the count of valid group pairs.

postconditions.expression: output_int == sum(1 for g1 in range(1, k+1) for g2 in range(g1+1, k+1) if is_bipartite_union(g1, g2, c, edges))
postconditions.description: The output equals the number of pairs of distinct groups (g1, g2) such that the subgraph induced by students belonging to either g1 or g2 is bipartite.
